notes.title: Glitch the reality
notes.content:
How much can be done during one week jam?
It turned out quite a lot, an unusual idea for the game and creating a new concept of the game-player relationship. 
Do you like toying with the game, exploit bugs, torment NPCs? What if we turn it around and instead make you a lab subject? Are you able to think outside the box? Would you question your reality and manage to escape? Try and see.
